en: Black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing two theater performers in costume from the production "Die Schmiedin von Kent." One woman sits on an ornate armchair in a long dress while another stands beside her in a medieval-style tunic with a floral head wreath. The setting appears to be a stage interior. Printed credits at the top name the play and the actors Helena Forti and Waldemar Staegemann. At the bottom, the publisher and photographer are credited, along with the city Dresden and the year 1916.
